display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Rome puts you in the captain's seat over the real Eternal City. Menus in English and Italian.

THE REAL ROME
Real satellite, elevation and map data: St Peter's Basilica and Michelangelo's dome, St Peter's Square, the Colosseum, the Forum, the Pantheon, the Vittoriano, Castel Sant'Angelo, the Spanish Steps, the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, EUR's square Colosseum, the aqueducts and 40 Tiber bridges. Four airports: Fiumicino, Ciampino, Urbe and Pratica di Mare.

A LIVING CITY
The Leonardo Express, the Roma-Lido, the regionals and a Frecciarossa on their real tracks, traffic on the roads, umbrella pines, yachts off Ostia. At night the domes, the bridges and the Colosseum light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Gianicolo, the domes of Rome out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: Fiumicino and Ciampino approaches, a Tiber run, the Vatican pass over the dome, the Alban lakes, a fighter scramble, Rome by night and a Rome tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat is off until you turn it on.
